name: ARTROBOT Series Humanoid Robots
summary:
The ART humanoid series is ARTROBOT's family of large bipedal robots, developed across successive generations to study robot movement, intelligence and control. The company describes work on a motion-control architecture and robot operating-system development alongside its hardware programme.

The family also sits within ARTROBOT's education and engineering-training activities, which cover robot structure, control and system integration. This is a series-level catalog entry; joint layouts, dimensions and demonstrated functions vary by generation and should be checked against the individual ART
